units.rawText: I feel like I'm becoming more outgoing recently... Oh my, oh my, the Oasis is such an enchanting place.

units.rawText: I was always quiet before, blending in with the calm of the island, only keeping to myself. Now, I find myself talking to you about all kinds of things without even realizing it. The old me would probably mock me and call me a granny for talking so much.

units.rawText: ...You like... the current me better? You're so sly with your words, Professor... The perfect excuse to embrace my changes just came from your mouth so naturally... Ahem. Speaking of which, this is a sunflower I grew—my first attempt at cultivating flowers bereft of any toxins. It was a challenge, but I found quite a bit of joy in it...
